content: {"episode_id":"ep-05073","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Cornerstone United denied CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring) under CO-97 as bundled and not separately payable, and we appeal on medical necessity. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Per the note, cardiac event monitoring is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances through extended ambulatory assessment. We therefore request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 280.18 for this separately indicated service."}
